Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

Yes, in many cases an order can be canceled after it’s placed, but the timing matters, so it’s best to request it as soon as possible.

A few key details:

If the order is still scheduled for shipment and hasn’t gone out yet, cancellation may still be possible.
If the order is set to ship very soon, our team may need to review it first.
If the order has already shipped, it can no longer be canceled. In some cases, we may be able to request a package recall for $22 per box.
Orders with custom engraved tags or stakes may need special review.

If you’d like, send me your order number and the email used on the order, and I can help check your specific order.

Will I get an email confirmation once the change is made?

Yes, you’ll receive an email any time a significant change is made to an order, such as:

a cancellation or refund being processed
a delivery date being updated
items being removed or adjusted

I recommend keeping an eye on the same email address you used at checkout; that’s where any update notices will be sent. If you don’t see anything, it’s also worth checking your spam or promotions folder.
